summary: Replace automation mesh certificates: stop receptor, create a CA with receptor --cert-init, make a CSR per node with --cert-makereq, sign with --cert-signreq, copy certs to /etc/receptor/tls/ (CA in tls/ca), set receptor ownership and 0640, start receptor and check nodes are Ready.
questions: How do I generate custom certificates for receptor?
Mesh node Unavailable after replacing certificates
What permissions do receptor certificate files need?

answer_card.title: Custom signed certificates for automation mesh
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
systemctl stop receptor
receptor --cert-init commonname="common ca" bits=4096 outcert=/etc/receptor/tls/ca/mesh-CA.crt outkey=/etc/receptor/tls/ca/mesh-CA.key
receptor --cert-makereq commonname=<FQDN> bits=4096 nodeid=<FQDN> outreq=/etc/receptor/tls/<FQDN>.csr outkey=/etc/receptor/tls/<FQDN>.key ipaddress=<IP>
receptor --cert-signreq verify=yes cacert=/etc/receptor/tls/ca/mesh-CA.crt cakey=/etc/receptor/tls/ca/mesh-CA.key req=/etc/receptor/tls/<FQDN>.csr outcert=/etc/receptor/tls/<FQDN>.crt notafter="2034-07-29T20:48:02Z"
# copy to each node, then
chown -R receptor: /etc/receptor; chmod 0640 /etc/receptor/tls/<FQDN>.crt
systemctl start receptor
```
Check **Instance Groups > default > Instances** are Ready; run a health check on any Unavailable node.
